description: This file contains the implementation of the Api class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.User namespace. It provides methods for managing API entries, IP addresses, sessions, and related operations for user APIs in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Provides API management functionalities such as adding, editing, deleting APIs, IP management, session handling, and retrieving API data.

methods.name: addApi
methods.description: Adds a new API entry to the database with associated IPs, returning the new api_id.

methods.name: editApi
methods.description: Updates an existing API record identified by api_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes the API record identified by api_id.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific API by api_id.

methods.name: getApis
methods.description: Retrieves a list of APIs with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalApis
methods.description: Returns the total count of API records.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Associates an IP address with a specific API.

methods.name: deleteIp
methods.description: Deletes all IP addresses associated with an API.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a specific API.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Creates a session record for an API with session ID and IP, returning the session's last inserted ID.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves all session records for an API.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a specific session by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSessionsBySessionId
methods.description: Deletes session(s) associated with a specific session ID string.
